title: MITRE as the place to look for the legacy program
summary: Jordan tells of MITRE as the place to look for the legacy program, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: if you want to look at legacy program stuff, I'd look at MITER.

plain: A man called Jordan, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says that anyone looking for the "legacy program", a supposed decades-old secret effort to study recovered non-human craft, should look at MITRE. MITRE is a US nonprofit that runs research centres for the government. If true, it would point to where such a hidden programme sits.
